en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a wooden building surrounded by trees, labeled 'Sundsvall. Utsiktstornet.' (meaning 'Sundsvall. The Observation Tower'). The reverse side shows handwritten text in Swedish, a green Swedish stamp (5 öre), and addresses written in ink. The design follows the classic format of early 20th-century postcards, with printed 'CARTE POSTALE' and multiple translations of 'postcard.'
